services.desc: Add a unique outdoor experience to your Valle de Guadalupe itinerary with a scenic horseback riding adventure through Baja California wine country. Surrounded by vineyards, mountain landscapes, and open countryside trails, this activity offers a relaxing way to explore a different side of Valle beyond wineries and restaurants. Perfect for couples, weekend travelers, photographers, and visitors looking for outdoor activities in Valle de Guadalupe, this horseback riding experience combines nature, scenic views, and Baja wine country atmosphere in one unforgettable stop during your trip. - This experience is non-refundable; however, rescheduling is available based on availability.
